profile_exclusions: normal equipment in main-only mode; included at level 240 in seasonal mode

stats_note: Levels use the in-game display. Main-only stats exclude equipment; seasonal stats include normal Lv. 240 equipment and exclude seasonal equipment. Exclusive equipment, charms, mastery, artifacts, mode normalization, and account bonuses are excluded.

exclusive_equipment.stats_note: Values are cumulative at the selected equipment level. *_PR fields are rendered as percentage-point bonuses from their field convention; secondary attributes are config points.
